description: Source code for the CRBrowser class and related classes in Playwright's Chromium backend, managing browser connections, contexts, pages, and DevTools sessions.

classes.name: CRBrowser
classes.description: Represents a Chromium browser instance, managing connections, pages, contexts, and DevTools integration.

classes.name: CRBrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context within CRBrowser, managing pages, cookies, permissions, and other context-specific settings.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Chromium browser over a transport, returning a CRBrowser instance.

methods.name: doCreateNewContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specified options.

methods.name: contexts
methods.description: Returns all active browser contexts.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the browser version string.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string.

methods.name: _platform
methods.description: Determines the platform based on user agent.

methods.name: isClank
methods.description: Checks if the browser is a 'clank' instance based on options.

methods.name: _waitForAllPagesToBeInitialized
methods.description: Waits for all pages to be initialized.

methods.name: _onAttachedToTarget
methods.description: Handles attachment to a new target (page, background page, service worker).

methods.name: _onDetachedFromTarget
methods.description: Handles detachment from a target.

methods.name: _didDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup after disconnection.

methods.name: _findOwningPage
methods.description: Finds the page owning a given frame ID.

methods.name: _onDownloadWillBegin
methods.description: Handles download start events.

methods.name: _onDownloadProgress
methods.description: Handles download progress events.

methods.name: _closePage
methods.description: Closes a page target.

methods.name: newBrowserCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new CDP session for the browser.

methods.name: startTracing
methods.description: Starts tracing with specified options.

methods.name: stopTracing
methods.description: Stops tracing and saves the trace artifact.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the browser is connected.

methods.name: _clientRootSession
methods.description: Gets or creates the root CDP session.
